hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A shadow pair (i, j) with i < j satisfies the index relation nums[j] - nums[i] == j - i.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Rearrange the equation to isolate single-variable terms: nums[i] - i == nums[j] - j.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Count occurrences of each difference value and accumulate pairs using combination formula n * (n - 1) // 2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulates frequency counts of normalized difference nums[i] - i.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all index pairs directly takes quadratic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Rearranges equality to group matching keys via frequency hashing.
